# ui-search

Search the sessions' transcripts: words, literal text, regexps or meaning.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-search.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-search.el)
- **Loaded:** when enabled (see `harness-enable-modules`)
- **Requires:** [ui](ui.md)
- **Required by:** [ui-quick-search](ui-quick-search.md)

## About

C-c h g (`harness-search-sessions`) reads a query and shows the
sessions whose transcripts or names match it, best first, each with
its best matches: a snippet of the message, the words found in it
highlighted.  RET on a match opens its session there, with point on
what was found; on a session's line it opens at its best match.

The search is the harness's own (`session/search`, see
harness-session-search.el), in one of four modes:

  text      words, in any form: the full-text index, ranked; a
            "phrase", word*, OR and -word are understood
  literal   the text exactly as typed
  regexp    an extended regular expression
  meaning   what is near in meaning, by the embedding model
            (`harness-session-search-embedding-model`)

m cycles the mode, a widens the search to every project or narrows
it to the one it was started from, s asks another query, g searches
again, + shows more sessions, and n and p go from match to match.

Opening a session at a hit is a function of its own
(`harness-ui-search-visit`, with `harness-ui-search-hit-regexp` for
the words to put point on), which the quick search's [Open] uses too
(harness-ui-quick-search.el).

## Provides

### Commands

- `harness-search-sessions` — Search the sessions' transcripts for QUERY and show what matches.
- `harness-ui-search-again` — Search again for the same query.
- `harness-ui-search-cycle-mode` — Search again in the next mode: words, literal, regexp, meaning.
- `harness-ui-search-more` — Show more of the sessions that match.
- `harness-ui-search-mouse-open` — Open the session of the match clicked in EVENT.
- `harness-ui-search-new` — Search for QUERY instead, the same way.
- `harness-ui-search-next` — Move to the next match, a session's best at its line.
- `harness-ui-search-open` — Open the session of the match at point there, point on what was found.
- `harness-ui-search-previous` — Move to the previous match.
- `harness-ui-search-set-mode` — Search again in MODE: "text", "literal", "regexp" or "semantic".
- `harness-ui-search-toggle-scope` — Search again in every project, or only in the one the search started from.

### Options

- `harness-ui-search-default-mode` — How `harness-search-sessions` searches unless told otherwise.
- `harness-ui-search-default-scope` — Which sessions `harness-search-sessions` searches at first.
- `harness-ui-search-max-matches` — How many matches a search shows of each session.
- `harness-ui-search-max-sessions` — How many sessions a search shows at first; + shows more.

## Uses

### Methods it calls

- `session/search` ([session-search](session-search.md))
